Dolly Parton is receiving a longer period of national mourning than several major political figures. President Donald Trump ordered U.S. flags to fly at half-staff for one week following Parton’s death, with the order remaining in place until sunset on September 1. Pope Francis was honored for five days, while the other tributes were shorter. Trump praised Parton as one of the “greatest Country singers” and said her death was a “true loss for millions.” The decision is particularly notable because Parton largely avoided partisan politics throughout her career and had previously declined offers of the Presidential Medal of Freedom from both Trump and Joe Biden. #DollyParton #DonaldTrump #USNews #CountryMusic #MusicNews
